metaTitle: Custom Cotton Gift Sets & Bundles | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton gift sets & bundles with your logo. Perfect for corporate gifts, swag bags, and employee appreciation. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Cotton gift sets and bundles offer a soft, natural feel that recipients appreciate, whether you are assembling welcome kits for new hires, putting together swag bags for a trade show, or creating corporate gifts for clients. Cotton totes like the Basic Cotton Tote pair naturally with a custom-printed Gildan Softstyle T-shirt or a Port & Company Essential Tee for a coordinated, comfortable giveaway. The breathable fabric takes screen printing and embroidery cleanly, so your logo stands out without looking stiff or plasticky.
heroAltText: A custom cotton gift set bundle with a branded tote bag and T-shirt, ideal for corporate gifts and promotional events.
